english: A four-digit number is formed by choosing each of its digits from $\{1,2,3,4,5\}$, repetition of digits being allowed, all such numbers being equally likely. Let $p$ be the probability that the number formed is greater than the number obtained by writing its digits in the reverse order. Then the value of $625p$ is ______.
hindi: एक चार अंकों की संख्या इस प्रकार बनाई जाती है कि उसका प्रत्येक अंक $\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ से चुना जाता है, अंकों की पुनरावृत्ति की अनुमति है, तथा ऐसी सभी संख्याएँ समसम्भाव्य हैं। माना कि $p$ इसकी प्रायिकता है कि बनी हुई संख्या, उसके अंकों को उल्टे क्रम में लिखने से प्राप्त संख्या से बड़ी है। तब $625p$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Total $5^{4}=625$ numbers. Reversal is a one-one correspondence on these numbers
A number equals its reverse iff $d_{1}=d_{4}$ and $d_{2}=d_{3}$: $5\cdot5=25$ numbers
The other $600$ split into pairs $\{N,\overline{N}\}$ with exactly one member larger, so $300$ numbers exceed their reverse
solution_full: Formation of numbers with repetition: each of the $4$ places can be filled in $5$ ways, giving $5^{4}=625$ equally likely numbers. No digit is $0$, so the reverse of each is again one of these numbers.
Let $\overline{N}$ denote the reverse of $N=d_{1}d_{2}d_{3}d_{4}$. The map $N\mapsto\overline{N}$ is a bijection of the $625$ numbers onto themselves and $\overline{\overline{N}}=N$.
$N=\overline{N}$ exactly when $d_{1}=d_{4}$ and $d_{2}=d_{3}$; choosing $d_{1}$ and $d_{2}$ gives $5\cdot5=25$ such numbers.

The remaining $625-25=600$ numbers fall into $300$ pairs $\{N,\overline{N}\}$ with $N\neq\overline{N}$, and in each pair exactly one number is the larger. So exactly $300$ numbers are greater than their reverse.
originality_note: New: comparing a formed number with its own reversal, which pairs the numbers up so that only the self-reverse numbers need counting (way 4: a hidden symmetry). Closest known: 'four-digit numbers greater than 5000 formed from given digits' (NCERT). Different because: the condition compares each number with a number depending on it, and the count is done through the reversal pairing.
